<function name="GetToneMappingScaleLinear" parent="render" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Returns a vector representing linear tone mapping scale. See <page>render.SetToneMappingScaleLinear</page> for details.</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="scales" type="Vector">The tonemapping scales.
* X - Output scale.
* Y - Lightmap scale.
* Z - Reflection map scale.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
